lines.t: There's a fire in the word when it's spoken
It cuts through stone, it splits the heart
Like a sharp and two-edged sword
Some hear hope in the sound of truth
others feel the burn the same flame that lights the path is the fire that makes men turn you can't
stand still when the trumpet cries you either bow or you fight every soul will answer once
when the dark collides with light heed the call it's ringing now hear the warning in the sound
A shout, a witness, truth proclaimed
No middle ground, no neutral ground
Mercy calls you while it may
Words like fire upon the proud
out foreheads marked with flame tears will fall where hearts are pierced when truth exposes names
some are struck and rise again washed forgiven clean others clench their fists in rage and curse
what they have seen the blade is sharp the hour is near the line is clearly drawn every lie will
Mercy calls you while it may
This is judgment mixed with grace,
a choice that will not fail.
The word goes out, it will not fall.
Empty to the ground, it saves or it condemns.
Heed the call, the trumpet cries
Wake or rise, open your eyes
Truth has come, the door is near
Love still calls, but so does fear
Heed the call, choose life today
Turn your heart, don't walk away
The fire speaks, the word is true
Therefore hear the word of the Lord
And heed the call, a shout to the nations
A trumpet of alarm and war, truth proclaimed, judgment drawn.
For the day of the Lord comes in, for my words are fire and my truth is light.
and stand condemned in the end
Therefore hear the word of the Lord
For it is a call to repentance
A shout and a witness, a proclamation of truth, a trumpet of alarm and war, a declaration of judgment, a strong rebuke, says the Lord.
